findings.detail: All 29 Archer envelopes hash exactly, but the factual population is not wholly atomic or source-established. AR-B2-V7-001, -002, -013, -019, -022, and -026 each combine independently falsifiable atoms in one record/envelope. AR-B2-V7-017 labels a pointer/arrow collision as typed_answer without a typing anchor. AR-B2-V7-019 claims a positive configured projectile speed, while its cited lines only assign ARCHERS_REVENGE_CONFIG.enemy.projectileSpeed and do not establish sign. V14's substring table therefore returns green without validating every factual field or one-envelope-per-atom rule.
findings.required_remediation: Split every compound proposition into separately identified atomic records with exact envelopes, correct unsupported category metadata, add the configuration envelope needed for any sign claim or remove 'positive', regenerate the mapper, and drive semantic tests from every declared factual field rather than selected substrings.
